text:
Foods in the first photo: a lasagna portion (~250 g, ~400 kcal), a vegetable mix of carrots, corn and broccoli (~120 g, ~80 kcal), and a chocolate-coated bar (~40 g, ~190 kcal), plus water.

In the second photo, the lasagna plate has only a smear of sauce left, so most of it was eaten, perhaps 95%. The vegetable bowl is empty. The bar wrapper is empty, so the bar was eaten. A wooden stick is also on the tray, probably from the bar, which suggests it was an ice cream or similar bar.

Eaten totals:
- Lasagna: about 235 g, about 380 kcal
- Vegetables: about 120 g, about 80 kcal
- Bar: about 40 g, about 190 kcal

That comes to roughly 395 g and 650 kcal.
